detector_fail active at time of continued NS green, EW waiting 77

counterfactual.change: Set actuated=false to use fixed-time cycle; this removes the actuated gap-out logic that is confused by detector_fail, allowing regular cycling and no max_wait violation.

explanation: Actuated control with N detector_fail starting at 562. NS green is held from step 489 onward for >190s. At step 500 NS still green with queue S=67 but N=0 (failed). At 562 fail starts, but NS already green with no N queue. Appropriately, controller should gap-out NS (own detectors show no queue except S) and switch to EW which has demand, and max_green 87 should force switch plus recall for long-waiting EW. Instead NS green persists to step 686 (and beyond), causing E and W wait to reach 201s. The detector_fail on N apparently makes controller think NS still has demand or prevents gap-out/recall logic from triggering, also ignoring max_green and max_wait recall, starving EW.

violation.detail: approach 1 has waited 201 s at red with vehicles queued (limit 200)

vision_note: The signal remains green for the north-south approach while vehicles on the east and west approaches sit queued at red. From step 683 to 686 the pattern is unchanged with no service for the waiting EW direction, leading to the max_wait violation at 686.
